tns:patch.author: brianbrix
tns:patch.description: Adds a 'Footer Text' global setting so the site footer credit line can be overridden per deployment without a code change. When left blank, AMP falls back to the default "Developed in partnership with OECD, UNDP, WB, Government of Ethiopia and DG" text.

script.lang: INSERT INTO amp_global_settings (id, settingsname, settingsvalue, possiblevalues, description, section) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM amp_global_settings), 'Footer Text', '', '', 'Text shown at the end of the site footer, after the AMP version and build date. Leave blank to use the default credit line.', 'general' WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM amp_global_settings WHERE settingsname = 'Footer Text' );
